scientific_integrity: The candidate-separable monotonicity proof and direct wEJR budget argument establish the claim. Exact-arithmetic enumeration is a finite consistency check, not an infinite proof. The stronger wEJR+ follows from an explicitly cited published theorem for any MES completion; independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The online incentive guarantee concerns one current round with its history fixed, not global strategyproofness.
The wEJR proof concerns fully cohesive groups and does not claim strong temporal PJR or EJR.
Fallback payments are zero and fallback tie-breaking is independent of current approval reports.
Historical priority is not independently established.
title: An approval-responsive, online-strategyproof completion of temporal equal shares
